_comment: Azure Static Web Apps configuration. Azure ignores _redirects (Netlify) and
.htaccess (Apache), so the redirects, security headers and 404 handling all
have to be restated here. Keep this file in sync with those two if you edit them.
_trailingSlash_comment: Deliberately left at Azure's default ('auto'). Setting it to 'always' appends
a slash to EVERY path including files, so /robots.txt 301s to /robots.txt/ and
every css/js/image request costs an extra round trip. Canonical <link> tags
already declare the trailing-slash form, which is what search engines index.
_duplicate_route_comment: Azure normalises /who and /who/ to the SAME rule no matter what trailingSlash
is set to, and declaring both fails the whole deployment with 'a rule was
already processed with a duplicate route'. Declare the trailing-slash form
only — it matches both. Verified live against /who and /who/.
_navigationFallback_comment: Intentionally absent. navigationFallback is an SPA feature: it REWRITES any
unmatched route to a page and returns HTTP 200, which turns every bad URL into
a soft 404 that Google indexes as thin duplicate content. This is a multi-page
static site, so unmatched routes must return a real 404 status instead.

globalHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; form-action 'self' https:; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
